CYVAREN

You built it with AI. Is it safe to launch? CYVAREN reads your code without running it, answers six security questions in plain words and shows the file, the line and the fix for every problem it finds.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Apps built with AI coding tools go from idea to live in an afternoon. The same speed ships the classic holes: records anyone can read by changing a number in the address, admin pages with no role check, keys pasted into the code, login forms that accept guesses forever. Security scanners exist, but they speak to security teams, not to the person who just built the app.

02

What it does

Upload a .zip or import a public GitHub repository, and CYVAREN reads the code without running it. Six checks answer six questions in plain words, each marked passed, failed, not tested or inconclusive, with what it could not see. Every finding gives the file and line, why it matters, how to fix it and how to confirm the fix, and one click copies all of that as a prompt for an AI coding tool. An architecture map shows every route, database and outside service, and marks the paths to data that need no login; a written tour explains the app for six audiences. Scan again to see what was fixed, and export Markdown, SARIF or JSON. With AI assistance switched on, Claude explains a finding for your own code, answers questions about the project and drafts a fix in Repair Studio, which CYVAREN re-scans before showing you the diff; upgrades of vulnerable libraries are drafted by a rule, with no AI, and checked on OSV.dev.

03

How it is built

A TypeScript monorepo: a Fastify 5 API with Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL hosted by Neon, a Next.js 16 and React 19 front end, and a command-line tool that runs the same checks in CI. The analysis parses JavaScript and TypeScript into syntax trees to trace routes, guards and data access, looks for secrets with built-in rules and checks dependencies against OSV.dev; nothing in the project is installed or executed. On Vercel the API runs inside the web app and scans run after each response. AI requests go to Anthropic with no tools, secret values are masked before anything leaves, use is limited per workspace each day, and every workspace is isolated, with tests that check another workspace only ever gets not found. 108 unit and integration tests and 6 browser tests.
